Intake note (Commercial team, 10 August 2021). Our client Lakshmi Natarajan is a 54-year-old orthopaedic surgeon who lives at Flat 6A, Hanamkonda, Warangal 506042 and can be reached on +91 89996 21045 or lakshmi.natarajan@example.in. The client's PAN CWGPN9843K.
